messages:
Sam (Sales): FYI customer (federal contractor) asked if we can run an on-prem islanded POC in their air-gapped facility. Requirements: physical HSM, zero egress, courier-delivered install media, and a 4-week eval. They also want upgrade cadence guarantees and delta patching. Any immediate showstoppers?
Lina (Solutions Eng): No blockers but need details: which HSM model (Thales v. YubiHSM), how they expect activation tokens to be provisioned, and whether they accept signed USB or need an ISO burned by their team.
Sam (Sales): They have Thales Luna. Activation tokens will be signed by their internal PKI. USB is preferred for initial bundle; subsequent patches via signed delta bundles sent on USB or SCP to an internal registry.
Ravi (SRE): Implementation notes: we support detached signed bundles (ed25519) and produce incremental deltas. For a medium model the initial bundle ~9GB; deltas typically 50-200MB. Offline install flow uses signed manifest + sha256 verification. We'll need access to their CA cert to validate signatures during bootstrap.
Lina (Solutions Eng): Ops snippet for their runbook: ```bash
# verify bundle
openssl dgst -sha256 -verify customer-root.pub -signature bundle.sig bundle.tar.gz
sha256sum bundle.tar.gz | grep -F "<expected-hash>"
# install
./rwd-operator apply-bundle --bundle /mnt/usb/bundle.tar.gz --activation-token /mnt/usb/activation.jwt
```
Aisha (AE): Pricing sheet: POC services (4 weeks) = $28,000. One-time airgap packaging & signing fee = $6,000. HSM integration + on-site validation = $8k (variable). If they convert to dedicated/reserved we apply a PS credit.
Sam (Sales): They also submitted a lengthy security questionnaire. Which items usually need legal alignment?
SecOps (Legal): Common tricky items: telemetry (must be off by default), SBOM and signed provenance for all artifacts, vulnerability disclosure & patch timelines for air-gapped installs, indemnities around data exfiltration, and acceptance of manual patch windows. We'll draft answers but watch the CVE SLA ask 0 days is unrealistic for no-egress setups.
Ravi (SRE): Agree. Suggest we propose: quarterly scheduled patch windows + emergency signed-hotfix process with courier delivery for critical CVEs. We'll document rollback steps and verification hashes.
DeployBot: Generated manifest v2.0 (internal), detached signature created (ed25519).
Lina (Solutions Eng): Deliverables I can produce: 1) airgap install runbook + validation checklist, 2) delta patch acceptance test plan, 3) sample activation token workflow docs, 4) suggested patch cadence language for the contract. I can have drafts by EOD tomorrow.
Aisha (AE): Can legal aim to return the filled questionnaire by Monday COB? We need to send the proposal Tuesday to meet their kickoff.
SecOps (Legal): I'll prioritize the questionnaire and include SBOM export. Flagging that contract should include exceptions for offline remediation timelines.
Sam (Sales): OK. I'll confirm the node count (they said 3 controllers) and expected throughput (they mentioned 150 rps short sequences). I'll coordinate kick-off once proposal is out. :thumbsup:
